title: Nice Sunset Tour on the Sailboat
text: We really enjoyed our private Sunset tour! Nice views along the way, nice athmosphere on the boat and a delicious snack and white wine. We recommend!
author: Doris_G

title: Fun sunny day on the water
text: Great time on the water! He was so nice to the five of us. We were able to swim in the water in a beautiful sunny day. Views from the water are gorgeous. Beautiful boat with wine and snacks. Thank you
author: Victoria_M

title: Fantastic experience
text: We had a fantastic boat ride with Asier - he was very welcoming and made us feel at home immediately and kept us topped up with drinks and snacks while we relaxed and admired the stunning view. Can’t recommend this enough!
author: Emma_H

title: Hen party
text: Wonderful experience, "il nostro capitano" very gentle and available. Guaranteed fun and total relaxation.
author: Lucy_M

title: The best host and the best boat!
text: I was with my friends to this experience and was awsome! Asier is an amazing host, he provided us cold drinks and tasty snacks! The skyline views are mazing! Highly recommend!
author: saramA838OU

title: My favorite in Barcelona
text: I recommend it 100%. We have had a very good time sailing. Away from the crowd of Barcelona streets. The captain very attentive and friendly.
author: Getaway701228

title: Perfect activity for groups, the views of Barcelona from the sea are wonderful
text:
It was the best activity we could have chosen to improve the group dynamics of my work team! In addition to the fact that the boat is a beauty and the captain was very attentive, we were able to collaborate all in the sailing maneuvers, the captain explained himself and directed us perfectly, it was very fun and instructive at the same time. 
The views of the city of Barcelona from the sea are spectacular! 
And Asier, the captain, made us not want anything, thank you very much for this experience! Highly recommended
author: Mariqdelmar

title: Five star trip
text: Asier the skipper was so welcoming and friendly. He provided us with everything we needed - a brilliant host. The yatch was lovely and everyone enjoyed having a refreshing swim in the Med. Thank you Asier. You made my husbands surprise present fantastic!!
author: Kim_L

title: Amazing
text:
We had the most amazing time! The food, the drinks, the sailing everything was excellent! 
This was definitely the highlight of our trip! Cannot recommend enough!
author: Tracey_P

title: Highly Recommended
text: Amazing experience, with the owner of the boat who is great, he has sailed across the Atlantic! This was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona!
author: Navigate775633
